scope: Read original MATLAB tables, existing converted TRC/MOT and healthy XML. No converter, ScaleTool, IK solve, integration, model/data/profile changes. Only diagnostic script/receipts written.

raw_probe.matlab_result: native batch exit 0; 16 requested file records; static fp/conditions absent for both subjects

converter_audit.marker_handling: Original XYZ numeric columns times MarkerScale=1; inferred TRC units mm; consumer converts mm to meters. No axis permutation, rotation or global translation.
converter_audit.ik_handling: Copies raw coordinates with pelvis translations in meters and rotational channels in degrees by default; remaps left knee/ankle and omits left subtalar/MTP in prosthetic 21-coordinate overlay.
converter_audit.grf_handling: Treadmill_L/R XYZ are copied in order to ground force1/2. All raw COP coordinates have absolute magnitudes <20, so auto PointScale=1 (meters). No COP origin translation.
converter_audit.torque_handling: Raw moments treated as about lab origin; free_vertical subtracts COP cross force then retains ground-Y torque. This does not translate marker or COP coordinates.
converter_audit.legacy_static_AB06_clock_note: Existing AB06 static TRC still spans0–3.99 rather than raw Header0–1.995; same400 spatial samples/means. AB07 fixed Header is0–2.175. This time reconstruction difference does not introduce the13.1917mm static marker mean offset.

axis_unit_evidence.raw_marker_unit: mm, confirmed against mm TRC and meter-scale healthy pelvis translation; raw marker unit metadata itself is empty
axis_unit_evidence.raw_fp_cop_unit: meter-compatible numeric scale; raw explicit unit metadata is empty
axis_unit_evidence.ground_vertical: Both healthy models explicitly gravity=(0,-9.80665,0); primary load is Treadmill_vy and OpenSim ground_force_vy. No new axes transform is applied by our converter.

global_vertical_translation_test.interpretation: A shift13.1917mm exactly explains LHeel alone but fails other markers. Bilateral and heel-toe contrasts change, which a uniform datum shift cannot cause. Different anatomies and local marker coordinates prove non-global components. A global additive component combined with anatomy/posture/marker-placement remains unidentifiable from these two different subjects alone.
global_vertical_translation_test.coordinate_covariance: Translating measured markers and pelvis translation by the same delta leaves body-local calibrated marker positions invariant. Translating both the world stations and true surface datum would also preserve signed contact clearance. Translating markers alone against a frozen AB06 plane is a data change, not evidence of the true physical floor.

physical_floor_and_footwear.COP_Y_zero_interpretation: Already zero in the original processed MATLAB table, so it is a stored reference-plane convention, not an independent measured static floor height. No acquisition transform/calibration record is available to establish whether that plane equals the physical top surface in the marker coordinate frame.
physical_floor_and_footwear.local_metadata: Marker/IK/fp table Description, VariableUnits, VariableDescriptions and UserData are empty. Speed table has s/m/s only. No local footwear, sole thickness, physical surface origin or floor calibration documentation found under these two raw subject directories.
physical_floor_and_footwear.healthy_ground_mesh: Both XML reference treadmill.vtp with visible=false and scale1; no corresponding local treadmill.vtp found. A visualization reference alone would not establish physical surface calibration.
physical_floor_and_footwear.external_evidence_needed: Official EPIC/Camargo acquisition/preprocessing documentation for marker/FP origin and axis transformations; subject/session-specific shoe/marker-placement or floor-calibration records for a unique13.1917mm causal attribution. Public generic methods may not resolve subject-specific datum.

conclusions: The13.1917mm LHeel static height difference already exists in raw acquisition tables; our conversion introduces no corresponding spatial shift or axis/unit error.

A pure uniform vertical translation is inconsistent with the measured distal marker cloud; changed local healthy marker coordinates and subject scaling/posture supply confirmed non-global contributions.
Physical floor/shoe datum is not certified by local files; COP_Y=0 alone cannot choose a correction or separate a residual global datum component.
No data/model/profile correction is justified solely by this audit; full healthy-coordinate geometry and physical hardware audits must be combined with these facts.
